description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case for display purposes. The functions handle various delimiters and capitalization rules to ensure consistent string normalization within the application's UI.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string with spaces, underscores, or hyphens into camelCase, handling multiple delimiters and whitespace, or returns the original value if it is not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string into Title Case, capitalizing the first letter of each word and the letter after apostrophes, handling delimiters like underscores and hyphens, and preserving accented characters.
